Class PlayerViewController

java.lang.Object
view.PlayerViewController
All Implemented Interfaces:
ViewController
public class PlayerViewController extends Object implements ViewController
Small marker around the table for each player. Shows the totem, name, food/PP, and a row of chips summarising the player's tribe.

      private void init(PlayerDto p, boolean isSelf, boolean isCurrent)
      Called by load(), it initializes the player pane view. It builds new FoodWidget and PpWidget and calls buildChips().

    • buildChips

      private void buildChips(TribeDto tribe)
      Called by init(), builds the chips showing the various cards stats and types. It divides the area it owns in rows (HBox) to organize the space in a more efficient way.
      Parameters:
      tribe - player's tribeDTO

    • buildIconChip

      private javafx.scene.layout.HBox buildIconChip(String iconFile, String text)
      Called by init, builds the different icon chips in a standard way to make them similar. If it does not find the icon uses text instead.
      Parameters:
      iconFile - the icon of the type of the card
      text - the name of the card
      Returns:
      HBox that is the chip
